    • findResourcesByFilter

      @Query("SELECT r FROM Resource r WHERE (:name IS NULL OR LOWER(r.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT(\'%\', :name, \'%\'))) AND (:description IS NULL OR LOWER(r.description) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT(\'%\', :description, \'%\'))) AND (:departmentId IS NULL OR r.department.id = :departmentId) AND (:mqttResource IS NULL OR r.mqttResource = :mqttResource)") List<Resource> findResourcesByFilter(@Param("name") String name, @Param("description") String description, @Param("departmentId") Integer departmentId, @Param("mqttResource") Boolean mqttResource)
